result.title: PanoUAV-Track: Full-Spherical UAV Visual Tracking in the Wild
result.summary: Existing UAV tracking benchmarks predominantly rely on perspective cameras with limited fields of view. Omnidirectional cameras enable full-spherical observation, yet tracking from moving UAV platforms remains largely unexplored. Unlike ground-level panoramic tracking, UAV-mounted omnidirectional cameras observe targets across both azimuth and elevation, introducing geometric challenges under equirectangular projection (ERP). To investigate this setting, we capture approximately \textbf{40 hours of real-world 8K panoramic UAV video} and construct \textbf{PanoUAV-Track} through temporal clip extraction, target annotation, and the integration of simulated sequences. The resulting benchmark comprises 1,895 sequences, 507,961 frames, and 2,872 annotated objects, covering real-world daytime and nighttime scenes alongside simulation, and supporting both visual and language-based target specification. Through extensive evaluations, we reveal a clear \textbf{perspective-to-spherical} generalization gap and identify tracking degradation associated with latitude-dependent distortion and ERP seam discontinuity. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{PanoUAV-Tracker (PUTrack)}, a geometry-aware tracking framework combining latitude-adaptive search and seam-aware periodic sampling. PUTrack improves zero-shot and in-domain tracking, particularly for seam-crossing targets. Code and benchmark resources will be available\footnote{\textcolor{tabpink}{https://libingyu01.github.io/PanoUAV-Track/}}.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建了基于无人机全向相机的 8K 全景视觉跟踪基准 PanoUAV-Track，并提出几何感知跟踪框架 PUTrack，用纬度自适应搜索与接缝感知周期采样缓解 ERP 投影畸变与接缝不连续带来的性能下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于无人机全景视觉跟踪的基准与方法工作，缺少 latent 推理状态、视觉证据筛选或训练监督方面的具体联系，ERP 畸变只是跟踪检测层面的几何问题，与 LVR 主线没有可核查的借鉴线索。
